## Parental OpControl 0.17.19

- **About in the parent dashboard.** The version/license block in the sidebar and **Version details** now open `/about`. The page shows the Parental OpControl shield, the OpControl IT lockup, the server version and build, the client versions reported by your devices, a link to the release notes, the license, and the generated third-party list.
- **Author line.** `/about` credits the project as created by Ziur · OpControl IT Solutions. This is the only place in the product where that name is shown; the kid view, README and footers stay as before.
- **License and copyright** moved from the sidebar to `/about`. The sidebar keeps the version, **Version details** and a short **© 2026 Ziur · License** link.
- **Built with AI** wording updated. Parental OpControl was designed, directed and tested by Ziur, with design, planning and code review by Claude (Anthropic), and code written with OpenCode using DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (DeepSeek). Every change was reviewed and tested by a person before release.
- The third-party list on `/about` is generated from the real server, dashboard, client and kid view dependency graphs, plus the bundled fonts and licenses.
- Both laptops use the normal catalog update. No Windows, PIN, family or Luna setting was changed.
